title: fix(workflow): replace the retired models in the preset workflows

@@ -13,6 +13,6 @@ Aggressive Fallback Workflow
 More aggressive fallback with parallel premium tier:
 
 1. Fast tier: GPT-4o-mini (sequential)
-2. Premium tier: GPT-4o + Claude 3.5 (parallel, both execute)
+2. Premium tier: GPT-4o + Claude Sonnet 4.6 (parallel, both execute)
 
 Guarantees high quality if fast tier fails

@@ -13,4 +13,4 @@ Balanced Adaptive Workflow
 Balances speed, cost, and quality:
 
 1. Standard tier (parallel): GPT-4o-mini + Gemini Flash
-2. Premium tier (parallel): GPT-4o + Claude 3.5 if standard uncertain
+2. Premium tier (parallel): GPT-4o + Claude Sonnet 4.6 if standard uncertain

@@ -13,5 +13,5 @@ Consensus-3 Fast (Lower Cost, Faster)
 Uses faster/cheaper models with same consensus approach:
 
 - GPT-4o-mini
-- Claude 3 Haiku
-- Gemini 2.0 Flash
+- Claude Haiku 4.5
+- Gemini 3.8 Flash

@@ -13,8 +13,8 @@ Consensus-3 Workflow Configuration
 Uses 3 high-quality models in parallel:
 
 - GPT-4o (OpenAI) - Strong reasoning
-- Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Anthropic) - Thoughtful analysis
-- Gemini 2.0 Flash (Google) - Fast and capable
+- Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Anthropic) - Thoughtful analysis
+- Gemini 3.8 Flash (Google) - Fast and capable
 
 Judge: GPT-4o evaluates on accuracy, clarity, and completeness

@@ -13,8 +13,8 @@ Fast-Fallback Workflow Configuration
 Uses layer-based execution with sequential groups:
 
 1. Fast tier: GPT-4o-mini (try first)
-2. Mid tier: Gemini 2.0 Flash (if fast fails)
-3. Premium tier: GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet (last resort)
+2. Mid tier: Gemini 3.8 Flash (if fast fails)
+3. Premium tier: GPT-4o or Claude Sonnet 4.6 (last resort)
 
 Each group runs sequentially - only proceeds if previous fails

@@ -12,5 +12,5 @@ Multi-Judge-3 Workflow (Lighter Version)
 
 3 models with 2 judges (more cost-effective):
 
-- GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini 2.0
-- Judged by GPT-4o and Claude 3.5
+- GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.8
+- Judged by GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 4.6

@@ -14,15 +14,15 @@ Uses 5 models across different providers:
 
 - GPT-4o (OpenAI)

-- Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Anthropic)
-- Claude 3 Haiku (Anthropic)
-- Gemini 2.0 Flash (Google)
+- Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Anthropic)
+- Claude Haiku 4.5 (Anthropic)
+- Gemini 3.8 Flash (Google)

 - GPT-4o evaluates accuracy & clarity
-- Claude 3.5 Sonnet evaluates reasoning & depth
-- Gemini 2.0 Flash evaluates completeness & coherence
+- Claude Sonnet 4.6 evaluates reasoning & depth
+- Gemini 3.8 Flash evaluates completeness & coherence
 
 Scores are averaged across all judges for final selection
